messages.content: I need to define permissions for a user on a certain resource. The resource ID is '123-resource', the user ID is 'user-456', and the permissions to assign are 'read' and 'write'.

function.name: AclApi_add_mapping
function.description: Adds an Access Control List (ACL) mapping to define permissions for users or groups on specified resources. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

resource_id.description: The unique identifier for the resource to which the ACL mapping will be applied.

user_id.description: The unique identifier of the user or group that the ACL mapping will be associated with.

permissions.description: A list of permission strings that define the access level for the user or group on the resource.

expiry_date.description: The expiration date for the ACL mapping in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'. Optional, defaults to null which indicates no expiration.

function.name: oidc_api_OidcApi_add_mapping2
function.description: Adds an OpenID Connect (OIDC) provider to client mapping to the system. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

provider.description: The unique identifier for the OIDC provider.

client_id.description: The client ID registered with the OIDC provider.

client_secret.description: The client secret associated with the client ID.

redirect_uris.description: A list of allowed redirect URIs for the client.

grant_types.description: The grant types the client is allowed to use.

response_types.description: The response types the client is allowed to use.

function.name: ldap_api_LdapApi_add_mapping1
function.description: Adds a new LDAP (Lightweight Directory Access Protocol) mapping to the system, allowing the integration of LDAP user groups with system roles. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

mapping_name.description: The unique name to identify this LDAP mapping.

user_group.description: The distinguished name (DN) of the LDAP user group to be mapped.

system_role.description: The system role to be associated with the LDAP user group.

description.description: A brief description of the mapping for administrative purposes.

is_active.description: Indicates whether the mapping is active or not.

function.name: acl_api_delete_mapping
function.description: Removes an Access Control List (ACL) mapping from a specified team and project. This action unlinks the team's access rights from the project. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

teamUuid.description: The UUID of the team from which the ACL mapping will be removed.

projectUuid.description: The UUID of the project from which the ACL mapping will be removed.

function.name: permission_api_PermissionApi_add_permission_to_user
function.description: This function grants a specified permission to a given user by updating the user's permission set. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

username.description: The unique identifier of the user, such as a username or email address, in the format of 'username@example.com'.

permission.description: The specific permission to be added to the user, such as 'read', 'write', 'edit'.
